description: This Java class 'InteropWrapperBuilder' provides a builder pattern for constructing 'CommandWrapper' objects related to interoperation actions such as registering account identifiers, creating transaction requests, quotes, and performing transfers within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: InteropWrapperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating 'CommandWrapper' instances for various interoperation actions such as account registration, deletion, transaction requests, quotes, and transfers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a 'CommandWrapper' object with the accumulated parameters.

methods.name: withJson
methods.description: Sets the JSON payload for the command and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: registerAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Prepares a command to register an account identifier with specified type, value, and optional sub-identifier or type.

methods.name: deleteAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Prepares a command to delete an account identifier with specified type, value, and optional sub-identifier or type.

methods.name: createTransactionRequest
methods.description: Prepares a command to create a transaction request.

methods.name: createQuotes
methods.description: Prepares a command to create a quote.

methods.name: performTransfer
methods.description: Prepares a transfer command with specified transfer action type.
